findings.claim: Chunk-only message and tool-call streams are accumulated but never completed.
findings.evidence: The TEXT_MESSAGE_CHUNK and REASONING_MESSAGE_CHUNK branches create messages with streaming: true, but only explicit *_MESSAGE_END events call endMessage. Likewise, TOOL_CALL_CHUNK creates pending calls, but only TOOL_CALL_END sets ended, and runClientTools filters out every call without ended. RUN_FINISHED does not finalize either chunk sequence. Consequently, a chunk-only answer remains visibly streaming after the run finishes, onMessage is never called, and chunk-only client tool calls never execute. This leaves the AG-UI event support required by UPG-10 incomplete.
findings.suggested_fix: Track and finalize chunk sequences according to AG-UI chunk semantics when they transition or the run terminates, including marking completed chunked tool calls eligible for client execution while preserving the interrupt execution prohibition.

findings.claim: The root package now eagerly loads DOM-dependent Custom Elements, breaking plain-Node and server-rendering imports of the existing React API.
findings.evidence: catalog.ts replaces the React basic catalog with eager imports of @a2ui/web_core/v0_9/basic_catalog and @a2ui/web_core/catalogs/basic/v1. The added scripts/dist-dom-globals.mjs explicitly records the resulting failure: the root entry defines classes extending HTMLElement and 'plain Node cannot import it'; the export scripts now install jsdom globals to work around it. This changes existing import behavior beyond the requested protocol migration and conflicts with A-7's requirement to preserve existing behavior.
findings.suggested_fix: Keep the root entry safe to import without DOM globals, using server-safe catalog definitions or a separately loaded browser implementation rather than requiring consumers and repository tooling to install synthetic DOM globals.
